use_cases: Users drag and drop files or click to upload documents and media
Forms capture file attachments with validation for file type and size
Applications display upload progress with animated feedback
Users manage file uploads with error handling and retry options
Dashboards track file upload status across different states
ai_summary: A drag-and-drop file upload component with animated upload illustration, multiple states (idle, dragging, uploading, error), file validation support, and custom progress simulation. Built with framer-motion for smooth transitions and designed for both light and dark modes. Suitable for any application requiring file uploads with visual feedback and error handling.
